item: USGS earthquakes: the five 0.6.1 rows of R548 (honest zero on 204, in-progress retry, refused rows gap live, 2100-12, no type ignore)
summary: An FDSN 204 reads as the header with no row, so a zero window is true zeros; a window reaching the month in progress retries a count mismatch once; refused event rows (not duplicates) count toward the comparison so their month is a gap live; the endtime is computed from the month index so 2100-12 is fetchable; the maxima comparison is typed.
